title: Dishwasher Salt Refill Forecast
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeconnect:dishwasher salt_level_pct=* cycles_per_week=*
| eval weeks_remaining=round(salt_level_pct/(cycles_per_week*2),1)
| where weeks_remaining<2
| sort weeks_remaining
description: Forecasts when dishwasher salt will run out based on the current level and recent cycle frequency.
value: Consumables are easiest to manage when you measure burn-down and buy just before the annoyance begins.
implementation: Capture salt level and rolling weekly cycle count from Home Connect or a companion export.
visualization: Table of dishwashers with salt level and estimated weeks remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It counts when the dishwasher is likely to need more salt soon.
